title: Stopbar EscalationStatus v1
description: GET /v1/decisions/{request_id} (CS-152, LLD §4.1, §9). Mirrors internal/model.EscalationStatus. `request` is an ActionRequest (action_request.v1.schema.json) and `decision` a Decision (decision.v1.schema.json); scripts/validate_corpus.py checks both nested objects against those schemas. HTTP status: 202 pending, 200 allowed, 403 denied or expired.

reasons.description: Escalated policy IDs an approver must cover.

resolved_by.description: Approver key id; absent for pending and expired.

decision.description: The escalate decision while pending, then the final decision.
